description: Known gaps for desktop/tools/check_slice_symbol_closure.py. A gap listed here is accepted; a gap listed but no longer observed is stale and fails the gate (a partial run judges only the gaps its checks can observe). Every slice appends the gaps it knowingly leaves and removes the ones it closes. closedByEvidence says how firm the owner is: roadmap = that slice's roadmap text names the symbol; proposed = the gap author's inference, to be confirmed or reassigned by the slice owner; unassigned = no roadmap slice owns it. retiredSeeds are roadmap seeds a generated shim already defines; the gate fails if one loses its definer.

retiredSeeds.reason: Roadmap seed DanmakuContentRepository.invalidateDanmakuSegment (upstream ccb37f85): the carried v029-bas-filter and v030-up-danmaku DanmakuManager archives call it. RETIRED, not open: the v046-danmaku-protocol slice carries the whole v0.4.6 DanmakuContentRepository.kt, and extract-upstream-media.py emits that object body as DesktopDownloadDanmakuRepository.kt, where the Windows download owner names the object DanmakuRepository, so the member has a compiled definer under that name. The carried archive file declares the upstream name DanmakuContentRepository with the member, which is what resolves the carried references in this gate; the compiled Windows object does not have that name, so the slice that emits DanmakuManager whole must map it. The desktop DanmakuWindowLoader calls the member through its default invalidateShared port, but the playback source (ApiDesktopDanmakuSource.segment) reads the API directly and never fills that repository cache, so for playback the call is a forward-compatible hook: only the loader's own cache eviction changes behaviour.
retiredSeeds.evidence: d6bf8b16:core-data/src/main/java/com/android/purebilibili/data/repository/DanmakuContentRepository.kt declares fun invalidateDanmakuSegment(cid: Long, segmentIndex: Int); the pinned v0.2.5 copy has no such member
retiredSeeds.retiredBy: desktop/tools/v046_danmaku_protocol.py advance_content_repository, applied by desktop/tools/extract-upstream-media.py and emitted as DesktopDownloadDanmakuRepository.kt

RETIRED, not open: the compiled Windows parse result is the desktop-owned DanmakuDocument, which now declares failedSegmentCount (parseProtobufWindow counts the failed segments and the window loader reads them). ParsedDanmaku itself stays uncompiled (extract-upstream-danmaku.py cuts AdvancedDanmakuData.kt before it) and is carried in v046-danmaku-protocol with the v0.4.6 AdvancedDanmakuData.kt. This identifier check matches by name only, so it cannot tell DanmakuDocument from ParsedDanmaku.
